data.name: Adityavat
data.gender_notes: Adityavat is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Aditya, the Sun God in Hindu mythology, and Vat, which means 'dweller'. The name Adityavat carries the meaning “Sun Dweller” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Adityavat usually hope their child will grow to embody sun dweller and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents someone who brings warmth, light, and positivity.
data.etymology: Adityavat belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun Dweller.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adityavat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_sanskrit.name: आदित्यवत्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Aditya means 'sun' and vat means 'born'. Hence, the name Adityavat means 'sun-born'.

in_hindi.name: आदित्यवत्
in_hindi.long_meaning: आदित्य सूर्य का अर्थ है और वत जनित का अर्थ है। इसलिए नाम आदित्यवत् का अर्थ है सूर्य जनित है।

in_tamil.name: ஆதித்யவத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஆதித்ய அர்த்தம் சூரியம் ஆனால் வத் அர்த்தம் பிறப்பு ஆகும். ஆதித்யவத் என்ற பெயரின் அர்த்தம் அது சூரிய பிறந்தவர் எனப்படும்.

in_telugu.name: ఆదిత్యవత్
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఆదిత్యం సూర్యం ఆయన అర్థం మరియు వత్ జనితం అర్థం. ఆదిత్యవత్ పేరు సూర్య జనితం అర్థం హేబ్.

data.cultural_impact: The name Adityavat holds a significant cultural heritage in Hinduism. Aditya, the name originates from Aditya or Surya, the Sun God, whose rays transform the earth with life and energy. Naming a child Adityavat acknowledges the child as a divine entity from the Sun God, believed to be a bringer of prosperity, wisdom, and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Adityavat acknowledges the divine connection of the child to the Sun God. It symbolizes the child's potential to shine brightly in this world, bringing warmth, light, and life, just like the sun does. It motivates the child to embody the qualities of the Sun God - truth, strength, courage, and enlightenment, helping them live a virtuous life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Adityavat means "One who approaches or resembles Aditya, the Sun God." It symbolizes the individual's connection to the divine light and radiance of the Sun God, representing the journey towards enlightenment and self-realization.

vedic_reference.root_origin: Sanskrit root āditya (sun) and suffix vat (born)
vedic_reference.note: This name is not from the Vedas or any other Hindu scriptures.

historical_references.reference: Adityavat was a legendary king of the Solar Dynasty, mentioned in Indian mythology and the Mahabharata epic. He is said to have ruled over Hastinapur, the ancient capital of the Kuru Kingdom. His rule is marked by prosperity, peace, and justice.

Another reference suggests that Adityavat was a historical king, ruling around 50 BC during the later Satavahana period. He is mentioned in the Andhra inscriptions, which describe him as a devout Shaivite and a great patron of temples.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Adityavat continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Lakshmi Adityavat from Kolkata, India embodies the meaning of Adityavat - "Sun Dweller". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
